SELECT id,sketch,HLL_SKETCH_ESTIMATE(sketch) AS n FROM (SELECT id,HLL_SKETCH_AGG(value,18) FILTER (WHERE id=2) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS sketch FROM inputs) ORDER BY id

SELECT id,sketch,HLL_SKETCH_ESTIMATE(sketch) AS n FROM (SELECT id,HLL_UNION_AGG(sketch) FILTER (WHERE id=2) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS sketch FROM (SELECT id,HLL_SKETCH_AGG(value,18) AS sketch FROM inputs GROUP BY id)) ORDER BY id
